versions.message: Vocabulary update: re-resolved against OMOP vocabulary v5.0 29-AUG-26 (previously v5.0 27-FEB-26). 6367 -> 6344 concepts. Removed 23 concepts deprecated in the new release, whose replacement is already in the set: amoxicillin / clavulanate Oral Suspension [AMOXA DUO] (2052568); amoxicillin / clavulanate Oral Suspension [CLACILLIN DUO] (2052587); amoxicillin / clavulanate Oral Suspension [CROANAN DUO] (2052598); 35 ML amoxicillin 80 MG/ML / clavulanate 11.4 MG/ML Oral Suspension [AUGMENTIN DUO] by Glaxosmithkline (36055818); 35 ML amoxicillin 80 MG/ML / clavulanate 11.4 MG/ML Oral Suspension [AUGMENTIN DUO] (36055819); and 18 more.
